comment: FUTURE era B-roll clip for the trailer / devlog (task 7). Scripted with tools/record.mjs — canvas-only capture, no HUD. Route is fully safe: it teleports between checkpoints (never walks off a ledge, never steps on the collapse bridge, never triggers the time rift) and shows the era's custom shaders in order: star dome + distant city lights + traffic (plaza), city towers + holo billboards (gap), phasing platforms (dissolve wave), pulsing energy barriers + sweeping lasers (gauntlet), the collapse bridge + Neon Core beam (pre-bridge), the containment field + colour-cycling nodes (sequence lock), then the real ending: warp-ripple restoration + flash. Camera control: __tp(x,y,z,yaw,pitch) teleports+framing, __panTo(yaw,pitch,ms) smooth-pans. yaw 0 faces -Z (down the course); positive pitch looks up.

steps.comment: PRIME — mount the real Future level through levels.load() and hold the pointer-lock flag so no stray event can pause the sim mid-record.
Inject the camera helpers: teleport+framing, smooth pan (smoothstep over ms), and a state peek for the log.

steps.eval: (() => { window.__tp = (x, y, z, yaw, pitch) => { const p = window.__game.player; p.rig.position.set(x, y, z); p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); p.yaw = yaw; p.pitch = (pitch === undefined ? -0.12 : pitch); p.facing = yaw + Math.PI; return true; }; window.__panTo = (yaw, pitch, ms) => new Promise((res) => { const p = window.__game.player; const y0 = p.yaw, q0 = p.pitch, t0 = performance.now(); const id = setInterval(() => { const k = Math.min(1, (performance.now() - t0) / ms); const e = k * k * (3 - 2 * k); p.yaw = y0 + (yaw - y0) * e; p.pitch = q0 + (pitch - q0) * e; if (k >= 1) { clearInterval(id); res(true); } }, 16); }); window.__state = () => JSON.stringify({ state: window.__game.levels.state, z: +window.__game.player.position.z.toFixed(1), mode: window.__game.mode() }); 'helpers-ready'; })()

steps.comment: Opening framing BEFORE recStart: on the plaza looking up-left at the skyline (star dome + distant lights + traffic in frame from the first captured frame).
SHOT A — plaza: pan down from the night sky / skyline to straight down the course (city towers + grid floor + star dome).
SHOT B — the dash gap: stand on the plaza edge (never jump it), sweep across the second pad and the mover field beyond.
SHOT C — moving platforms: from the catch pad, watch the sine-riding pads carry nothing but light (holo billboards behind).
SHOT D — phase platforms: from the far catch pad, watch the dissolve/re-form wave travel tile to tile (phase shader).
SHOT E — barrier gauntlet: watch the pulsing energy barriers + sweeping lasers for two full pulse cycles (2.9 s each).
SHOT F — pre-bridge: the intact collapse bridge (never stepped on, so no rift) and the Neon Core's light beam on the spire ahead.
SHOT G — sequence lock: containment field around the core, three colour-cycling nodes. Watch one 3.5 s colour beat, then solve it for the dissolve.
TAKE THE CORE — the pickup chime + core-get fanfare; the level's transition-out warp ripple charges, then the finale orbit begins.
Block until the finale actually starts (state flips to 'finale' ~1.55 s after takeCore), with a 30 s safety timeout.

steps.eval: new Promise((res) => { const t0 = performance.now(); const id = setInterval(() => { const s = window.__game.levels.state; if (s === 'finale' || s === 'won' || performance.now() - t0 > 30000) { clearInterval(id); res('finale-poll: ' + s); } }, 100); })

steps.comment: SHOT H — the real ending: restoration ramp (ripple charge = max(warp, restoring·0.75)), the 5.2–6.4 s final surge, ending on the white flash peak at ≈6.5 s (state flips to 'won' at 6.6 s — we stop just before).
